alert.no_microphone_message: {message} — check your input device, then try again.

alert.accessibility_refused_typing: macOS refused the typing: grant Accessibility to Whispy V2 (or to the terminal that launched whispy2) (System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility). ({detail})
login.approval: Approve Whispy V2 in System Settings → Login Items
